name: Semrush
description: Give your AI Semrush SEO data: domain overview and history, organic and paid keywords, competitors, keyword gap, keyword volume, difficulty and ideas, URL rankings and backlinks, with the API unit cost of every report.
instructions:
## Semrush
This connector calls the **Semrush API** (`https://api.semrush.com`, Standard API v3) with the user's own API key: Domain Overview, Organic and Advertising Research, competitors, Keyword Gap, keyword metrics and ideas, URL keywords and Backlink Analytics. Every tool is a read.

**Every report spends API units from the Semrush account, per line returned.** Each tool description states its price (10 to 80 units per line; historical data with `display_date` costs five times as much). `display_limit` defaults to 10 lines: raise it only when the user needs more, and never send 0, because Semrush then returns 10,000 lines. `semrush_get_api_units` is free and shows the balance (it also reads 0 for a key Semrush does not know); when units run short Semrush returns only the lines that were paid for, or `ERROR 132 :: API UNITS BALANCE IS ZERO`.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. API access needs a Semrush SEO **Business** subscription plus an API units package, bought under Subscription info, API units (https://www.semrush.com/accounts/subscription-info/api-units/). A new Business plan starts with zero units.
2. Open https://www.semrush.com/accounts/api-keys/active and copy an active v3 API key.
3. Paste it into `SEMRUSH_API_KEY` and install. Semrush takes the key as the `key` query parameter; it is stored encrypted, added to each request by the connector, and only sent to semrush.com.

**Tools**
- `semrush_get_api_units`: remaining API units (free).
- `semrush_domain_overview`: rank, organic and paid keywords, traffic and cost in one database (10 units).
- `semrush_domain_overview_all_databases`: the same per country (10 units per line).
- `semrush_domain_history`: monthly history of those metrics (10 units per month).
- `semrush_domain_organic_keywords`: keywords a domain ranks for (10 per line).
- `semrush_domain_paid_keywords`: Google Ads keywords of a domain (20 per line).
- `semrush_domain_organic_competitors`: organic competitors (40 per line).
- `semrush_domain_organic_pages`: a domain's ranking pages (10 per line).
- `semrush_keyword_gap`: shared, missing and unique keywords of up to five domains (80 per line).
- `semrush_keyword_overview`: volume, CPC, competition, intent, difficulty of one keyword (10).
- `semrush_keyword_overview_all_databases`: one keyword in every country (10 per line, about 140 lines).
- `semrush_batch_keyword_overview`: up to 100 keywords at once (10 per keyword).
- `semrush_keyword_organic_results`: the recorded Google top 100 for a keyword (10 per line).
- `semrush_related_keywords`: related keywords (40 per line).
- `semrush_broad_match_keywords`: broad-match ideas (20 per line).
- `semrush_keyword_questions`: question keywords (40 per line).
- `semrush_keyword_difficulty`: difficulty of up to 100 keywords (50 per keyword).
- `semrush_url_organic_keywords`: keywords one URL ranks for (10 per line).
- `semrush_backlinks_overview`: backlink summary and Authority Score (40 per request).
- `semrush_backlinks`: backlinks (40 per line).
- `semrush_referring_domains`: referring domains (40 per line).

**Reading the answers**: reports come back as text in CSV form, separated by semicolons (`;`), one header line with the column names and then one line per row (line breaks appear as `\r\n`). `Td` (trend) holds 12 comma-separated monthly values from 0 to 1. Column codes in `export_columns`: Ph keyword, Po position, Pp previous position, Pd position change, Nq monthly search volume, Cp CPC in USD, Co paid competition (0 to 1), Kd keyword difficulty (0 to 100), In intent (0 commercial, 1 informational, 2 navigational, 3 transactional; several comma-separated), Nr number of results, Ur URL, Tr traffic share (%), Tg traffic, Tc traffic cost share (%), Dn domain, Rk Semrush rank, Or organic keywords, Ot organic traffic, Oc organic traffic cost (USD), Ad paid keywords, At paid traffic, Ac paid cost, Cr competitor relevance, Np common keywords, Db database, Dt date, Rr related relevance, Pc keywords per page, Fk / Fp SERP feature codes. Fewer columns make a shorter answer but do not lower the price.

**Databases**: `database` is a two-letter country code (`us`, `uk`, `de`, `it`, `fr`, `es`...). Mobile databases (`mobile-us`) and extended ones (`us-ext`) exist for domain reports only.

**Filters**: `display_filter` takes the filter unencoded, `<sign>|<column>|<operation>|<value>`, several joined with `|`, e.g. `+|Nq|Gt|1000|+|Po|Lt|11`; the connector encodes it.

**Common errors** (the body is a line such as `ERROR 120 :: WRONG KEY - ID PAIR`)
- `ERROR 50 :: NOTHING FOUND`: Semrush has no data for this domain, keyword or database. Check the spelling and the database rather than retrying.
- `ERROR 120` / `ERROR 122` / `ERROR 402`: the API key is wrong. Copy it again from https://www.semrush.com/accounts/api-keys/active.
- `ERROR 130 :: API DISABLED`: the subscription has no API access (it needs an SEO Business plan with API units).
- `ERROR 132 :: API UNITS BALANCE IS ZERO`: no units left; buy more units in Semrush. The backlinks reports also answer it for a key Semrush does not know.
- `ERROR 133 :: DB ACCESS DENIED`: the plan does not include this database.
- `ERROR 429`: too many requests at once; wait a moment.

**Out of scope here**: Projects, Position Tracking and Site Audit (the v3 Projects API is deprecated by Semrush and its successor uses a different sign-in), the Trends (traffic) API, Local and Listing Management APIs, and subdomain or subfolder reports.

SEMRUSH_API_KEY.label: Semrush API key
SEMRUSH_API_KEY.help: Semrush, Account, API keys: an active v3 key. Needs an SEO Business plan with an API units package; every report spends units from it.
SEMRUSH_API_KEY.patternMessage: A Semrush API key is 32 characters, digits and the letters a to f in lower case. Paste only the key, without spaces or a key= prefix.

verifyHints.400: Semrush did not accept the API key. Copy it again from https://www.semrush.com/accounts/api-keys/active.
verifyHints.401: Semrush refused the API key. Copy it again from https://www.semrush.com/accounts/api-keys/active.
verifyHints.403: Semrush refused the request: the key is wrong, the subscription has no API access (SEO Business plan with API units), or the units are used up.
verifyHints.429: Semrush is rate limiting this key. Wait a moment and verify again.

prerequisites: A Semrush SEO Business subscription with an API units package, and an active v3 API key. Every report spends API units per line. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: semrush_get_api_units
tools.description: Show how many Semrush API units this key has left. Free: the call itself costs no units. Check it before a large report, because a report that runs out of units returns only the lines that were paid for. Semrush also answers 0 for a key it does not know, so if a report then fails with ERROR 120 or 122, the key is wrong.

tools.description: Backlink summary of a domain or URL: Authority Score, total backlinks, referring domains, URLs and IPs, follow and nofollow links, text and image links. Costs 40 API units per request. Returns semicolon-separated CSV.

target.description: Root domain (example.com), subdomain (www.example.com) or URL (https://www.example.com/page) to analyse.

target_type.description: What target is: root_domain (default) for the whole domain, domain for one subdomain, url for one page.

export_columns.description: Comma-separated column codes. Default ascore,total,domains_num,urls_num,ips_num,follows_num,nofollows_num,texts_num,images_num. Available: ascore, total, domains_num, urls_num, ips_num, ipclassc_num, follows_num, nofollows_num, sponsored_num, ugc_num, texts_num, images_num, forms_num, frames_num.

tools.name: semrush_backlinks
tools.description: Backlinks of a domain or URL: Authority Score of the linking page, source title and URL, target URL, anchor, nofollow, first and last seen (Unix time). Costs 40 API units per line. Returns semicolon-separated CSV.

target.description: Root domain (example.com), subdomain (www.example.com) or URL (https://www.example.com/page) to analyse.

target_type.description: What target is: root_domain (default) for the whole domain, domain for one subdomain, url for one page.

display_limit.description: Lines to return (default 10). Each line costs 40 API units, so keep it small. Never 0: Semrush then returns 10,000 lines.

display_offset.description: Lines to skip, for paging. Semrush counts display_limit from the start, so for lines 11 to 20 send display_offset 10 and display_limit 20 (you pay for the 10 returned lines).

display_filter.description: Backlink filter, unencoded, e.g. +|type||follow (followed links only), +|type||newlink, +|type||lostlink. Fields: type, zone, ip, refdomain, anchor, newlink, lostlink, urlanchor, redirects.

export_columns.description: Comma-separated column codes. Default page_ascore,source_title,source_url,target_url,anchor,nofollow,first_seen,last_seen. Available: page_ascore, response_code, source_size, external_num, internal_num, redirect_url, source_url, source_title, image_url, target_url, target_title, anchor, image_alt, last_seen, first_seen, nofollow, form, frame, image, sitewide, newlink, lostlink.

tools.name: semrush_referring_domains
tools.description: Domains that link to a domain or URL: Authority Score, number of backlinks, IP, country, first and last seen (Unix time). Costs 40 API units per line. Returns semicolon-separated CSV.

target.description: Root domain (example.com), subdomain (www.example.com) or URL (https://www.example.com/page) to analyse.

target_type.description: What target is: root_domain (default) for the whole domain, domain for one subdomain, url for one page.

display_limit.description: Lines to return (default 10). Each line costs 40 API units, so keep it small. Never 0: Semrush then returns 10,000 lines.

display_offset.description: Lines to skip, for paging. Semrush counts display_limit from the start, so for lines 11 to 20 send display_offset 10 and display_limit 20 (you pay for the 10 returned lines).

display_filter.description: Referring-domain filter, unencoded, e.g. +|newdomain|| or +|country||de. Fields: zone, country, ip, newdomain, lostdomain, category.

export_columns.description: Comma-separated column codes. Default domain_ascore,domain,backlinks_num,country,first_seen,last_seen. Available: domain_ascore, domain, backlinks_num, domain_trust_score, ip, country, first_seen, last_seen.
